title: Zeros to the End
statement: Move every 0 in an array to the end, keeping the other numbers in their original order. Do it in place with O(1) extra space and return the array.

keyPoints: write = 0; read goes through every index
When nums[read] is not 0, copy it to nums[write] and move write forward
Fill the rest from write to the end with 0
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Build a new array of non-zeros and add zeros: O(n) extra space

hints: A new array uses O(n) space. Can you overwrite the array as you read it?
Keep a write position for the next non-zero number.
After the pass, everything from the write position on becomes 0.
